title: Application Management & Credentials Overview
description: Production Dashboard Studio - Azure AD Identity Management Control Panel

tokens.value: sourcetype="azure:aad:audit" category="ApplicationManagement" activityDisplayName="Add application" | eval Creator=coalesce('initiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName', 'initiatedBy.app.displayName', "Automated System/Unknown") | eval AppName=mvindex('targetResources{}.displayName', 0) | table _time Creator AppName result | rename _time as "Creation Time", Creator as "Created By (User or App)", AppName as "Registered App Name", result as "Execution Status"

tokens.value: index=msgraph_prod sourcetype="microsoft:applications"  | where isnotnull('keyCredentials{}.endDateTime') | table appId displayName keyCredentials{}.displayName keyCredentials{}.startDateTime keyCredentials{}.endDateTime keyCredentials{}.type | rename appId as "App ID", displayName as "App Name", keyCredentials{}.displayName as "Certificate Description", keyCredentials{}.startDateTime as "Start Time", keyCredentials{}.endDateTime as "Expiry Date", keyCredentials{}.type as "Type"

tokens.value: index=msgraph_prod sourcetype="microsoft:applications"  | mvexpand keyCredentials{}.endDateTime  | eval expiry_clean=substr('keyCredentials{}.endDateTime', 1, 19)  | eval expiry_epoch=strptime(expiry_clean, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")  | eval now=now(), max_window=now+(7*24*60*60)  | where expiry_epoch >= now AND expiry_epoch <= max_window  | table appId displayName keyCredentials{}.displayName keyCredentials{}.endDateTime | rename appId as "App ID", displayName as "App Name", keyCredentials{}.displayName as "Expiring Cert Description", keyCredentials{}.endDateTime as "Expiration Timestamp"
